summary: abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund (NYSE: ASGI) filed an 8-K announcing results of its transferable rights offering, which ran September 21, 2026 to the October 15, 2026 expiration. The offering entitled holders to subscribe for up to 10,545,755 common shares; approximately 3,582,068 shares are expected to be issued for gross proceeds of about $70 million before expenses. The final subscription price was $19.28 per share, set at 92.5% of the lesser of the five-day average closing price or NAV. Shares are expected to be issued on or about October 22, 2026. What to watch: subscription take-up of roughly 34%, dilution, and NAV accretion.
